fix: move-resilient logging + fail-closed evidence + duration-from-disk classification
one_writer: Terminal-0 (standalone harness scripts; product repo untouched)

behaviors.1_fixed_root: all duration-critical logs write to $HOME/.foundergate/runs/<run_id>/ (and /level2-proof subdir), never the Desktop folder
behaviors.2_desktop_convenience_only: Desktop run folder holds only human-readable summary + index/symlink; authoritative logs are in the fixed root
behaviors.4_write_success_checked: fg_append verifies the file byte count grew after each append
behaviors.5_fail_closed: on any write/mkdir/writable failure -> fg_held writes status.json state=HELD_EVIDENCE_WRITE_FAILURE, loop exits 3, no PASS; if root unreachable, marker + message go to stderr and process still exits nonzero
behaviors.6_duration_from_disk: fg_duration_classify.mjs decides verdict ONLY from monitor+ledger timestamp spans
behaviors.7_timer_never_pass: driver reaching wall-clock minimum writes TIMER_MINIMUM_REACHED, explicitly 'NOT a pass'; classifier decides
behaviors.8_desktop_move_survives: logs live in fixed root, unaffected by Desktop folder relocation
